retrievalProfile.description: Generates a 90s-style music cover featuring a central group portrait against a dark background with radial vector outlines and a prominent rounded-corner corner badge.
triggerTerms: rounded corner text badge in top left
cyan and lime green color palette

recipe.visualDefinition: A central trio of figures in dark clothing and animal prints, set against a deep blue-to-black gradient background. The background is populated by a radial burst of thin, cyan-outlined geometric shapes. A large, bright cyan badge with rounded corners sits in the top-left, containing bold, stacked typography in lime green and cyan.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized human subjects against a dark, patterned void
High-contrast color relationship between lime green, cyan, and black
Radial symmetry of background elements pointing toward the center
Top-left corner dominance of the graphic badge
coreInvariants: Radial repetition of a single geometric outline shape
Rounded-corner rectangular badge in the upper-left quadrant
Halftone or fine-grain texture overlay across the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures positioned centrally, waist-up, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright cyan badge in the top-left corner acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left badge to the central figures, then follow the radial lines outward to the edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space around the central figures, filled with subtle vector outlines.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and black background providing depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cyan for the badge and radial outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime green for primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements against low-value, dark photographic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals and corners to match the badge shape
Lowercase 'dj' style with interlocking or overlapping forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'd' and 'j' are merged into a single graphic unit with a shared baseline and rounded outer edges.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors to maintain graphic unity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thick, rounded geometric feel of the 90s era.
Provides the necessary geometric structure for the badge text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A trio of people in 90s club attire (one in tiger print) centered against a dark navy gradient background with a radial pattern of cyan geometric outlines and a fine halftone texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bright cyan rounded-corner badge in the top-left corner. Inside the badge, stack bold lime green and cyan geometric sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the badge in the top-left corner?
Are the background outlines arranged radially?
Is the color palette strictly cyan, lime, and dark navy?
Does the image have a subtle halftone texture?

adjustableVariables: Subject clothing patterns (e.g., leopard vs tiger)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible within the badge
Verify radial lines converge behind the subjects
Check that the halftone texture doesn't obscure facial features
Confirm the lime green and cyan contrast is vibrant
